doc:
# Lifshitz — Non Relativistic

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “Lifshitz holography”).

claims.name: underlying_geometrical_structure_lifshitz_holography
claims.statement: Underlying geometrical structure of Lifshitz holography identified via holographic dictionary

claims.name: flows_provide_further_insight_into
claims.statement: The flows provide further insight into holography for Lifshitz geometries.

claims.name: deformations_lifshitz_holography_investigated_dimensional
claims.statement: Deformations of Lifshitz holography are investigated in $(n+1)$ dimensional spacetime.

claims.name: lifshitzinvariant_hydrodynamics_holography_generalized_arbitrary
claims.statement: Lifshitz-invariant hydrodynamics from holography is generalized to arbitrary hyperscaling-violating Lifshitz scaling theories with an unbroken $U(1)$ symmetry.

sources.title: Hyperscaling-Violating Lifshitz hydrodynamics from black-holes: Part II

claims.name: deformations_gaussbonnetlifshitz_holography_occur_dimensional
claims.statement: Deformations of Gauss-Bonnet-Lifshitz holography occur in (n + 1) dimensional spacetime.

sources.title: Deformations of Lifshitz holography with the Gauss-Bonnet term in ($n+1$) dimensions

claims.name: ho_ava_gravity_theory_possesses
claims.statement: Hořava gravity theory possesses global Lifshitz space as a solution and is conjectured to provide a natural framework for Lifshitz holography.

sources.title: Asymptotically Lifshitz spacetimes with universal horizons in $(1 + 2)$ dimensions

claims.name: higherorder_curvature_corrections_lifshitz_holography
claims.statement: Higher-order curvature corrections to Lifshitz holography are under control and have a sensible physical interpretation.

claims.name: holography_lifshitz_spacetimes_studied_epsilon
claims.statement: Holography for Lifshitz spacetimes is studied at $z=1+\epsilon^2$ with small deformation parameter $\epsilon$.

sources.title: Lifshitz as a deformation of Anti-de Sitter

claims.name: schr_dinger_symmetries_enforce_entire
claims.statement: Schrödinger symmetries enforce that the entire boundary geometry for Lifshitz holography is dictated by local Schrödinger invariance.

sources.title: Torsional Newton-Cartan Geometry and the Schrödinger Algebra

claims.name: holography_lifshitz_spacetimes_corresponds_dual
claims.statement: Holography for Lifshitz space-times corresponds to dual field theories on a fixed torsional Newton-Cartan background.

sources.title: Field Theory on Newton-Cartan Backgrounds and Symmetries of the Lifshitz Vacuum

claims.name: lifshitz_holography_serves_efficient_framework
claims.statement: Lifshitz holography serves as an efficient framework for anomalous transport in strongly coupled non-relativistic quantum matter.

claims.name: tnc_boundary_geometry_expected_universal
claims.statement: The TNC boundary geometry is expected to be universal in Lifshitz holography for all values of $z>1$.

sources.title: Torsional Newton-Cartan Geometry and Lifshitz Holography

claims.name: realtime_holography_spinorial_fields_considered
claims.statement: Real-time holography for spinorial fields is considered on Anti-de-Sitter (AdS) and more generally on Lifshitz spacetimes.

sources.title: Holographic Renormalization for Fermions in Real Time

claims.name: establishes_holography_lifshitz_spacetimes_dynamical
claims.statement: Establishes holography for Lifshitz spacetimes with dynamical exponent $z=1+\epsilon^2$ by showing the dual field theory is a specific deformation of relativistic CFT; renormalization maps conformal to Lifshitz invariance, and QFT arguments demonstrate such deformations generically yield Lifshitz scaling.

sources.title: Lifshitz as a deformation of Anti-de Sitter

claims.name: also_introduces_extended_schr_dinger
claims.statement: It also introduces an extended Schrödinger algebra whose Chern-Simons theory yields a new nonprojectable conformal Hořava-Lifshitz gravity, dubbed Chern-Simons Schrödinger gravity. This theory has a $z=2$ Lifshitz vacuum, providing a new setting for Lifshitz holography.

sources.title: Non-Relativistic Chern-Simons Theories and Three-Dimensional Horava-Lifshitz Gravity

claims.name: holography_used_investigate_scrambling_properties
claims.statement: Holography is used to investigate scrambling properties for non-conformal black Dp brane backgrounds, asymptotically Lifshitz black holes, and Gauss-Bonnet black AdS solutions.

sources.title: Extending the scope of holographic mutual information and chaotic behavior

claims.name: holography_suggests_lifshitzlike_fixed_points
claims.statement: Holography suggests that Lifshitz-like fixed points can be obtained from various four-dimensional CFTs, including ${\cal N}=4$ super Yang-Mills, via RG flows.

sources.title: On String Theory Duals of Lifshitz-like Fixed Points

claims.name: gravity_solutions_describing_renormalization_group
claims.statement: Gravity solutions describing renormalization group flows from relativistic to non-relativistic conformal theories are constructed in both a phenomenological massive vector model and $N=4$, $d=6$ gauged supergravity. These flows illuminate holography for Lifshitz geometries and provide field theory descriptions of Lifshitz duals.
